name: Read Paired
description: The read is part of a paired-end sequencing record.
inclusionPhrase: Includes reads that are part of a paired template.
exclusionPhrase: Excludes reads that are part of a paired template.

name: Proper Pair
description: Each segment is aligned as a proper pair.
inclusionPhrase: Includes reads marked as properly paired.
exclusionPhrase: Excludes reads marked as properly paired.

name: Read Unmapped
description: The segment is unmapped; the aligner did not find a suitable alignment for the read.

name: Mate Unmapped
description: The segment's mate is unmapped; the aligner did not find a suitable alignment for the mate.
inclusionPhrase: Includes reads with an unmapped mate.
exclusionPhrase: Excludes reads with an unmapped mate.

name: Read Reverse Strand
description: The segment sequence is reverse complemented relative to the reference orientation.
inclusionPhrase: Includes reads marked as reverse strand.
exclusionPhrase: Excludes reads marked as reverse strand.

name: Mate Reverse Strand
description: The mate sequence is reverse complemented relative to the reference orientation.
inclusionPhrase: Includes reads whose mate is marked as reverse strand.
exclusionPhrase: Excludes reads whose mate is marked as reverse strand.

name: First in Pair
description: The segment is the first segment in the template.
inclusionPhrase: Includes reads marked as first in pair.
exclusionPhrase: Excludes reads marked as first in pair.

name: Second in Pair
description: The segment is the second segment in the template.
inclusionPhrase: Includes reads marked as second in pair.
exclusionPhrase: Excludes reads marked as second in pair.

name: Secondary Alignment
description: The segment is not a primary alignment.

name: Fails Quality Checks
description: The segment fails platform/vendor quality checks.
inclusionPhrase: Includes reads that fail quality checks.
exclusionPhrase: Excludes reads that fail quality checks.

name: Duplicate
description: The segment is either a PCR duplicate or an optical duplicate.

name: Supplementary Alignment
description: The segment is a supplementary alignment.
